metadata.core_objective: Integrate concepts across all modules into a unified family governance framework.

topics.title: Program Integration Lifecycle
topics.summary: Synthesis of expectations, emotional regulation, restorative repair, and autonomy transition.

topics.title: Neurodiversity & Executive Function Adaptations
topics.summary: Tailoring accountability for ADHD and executive dysfunction.
strategies: Externalize memory through visual checklists and timers.
Shorten feedback loops for immediate cause-and-effect recognition.
Differentiate wilful defiance from skill deficits.

multiple_choice_exam.question: Which sequence correctly describes the 3-step de-escalation framework?
options: A) Reason -> Regulate -> Relate
B) Regulate -> Relate -> Reason
C) Relate -> Reason -> Regulate
D) Regulate -> Reason -> Relate

multiple_choice_exam.question: How does a logical consequence differ from a punishment?
options: A) Logical consequences are directly connected to the behavior and focus on repair; punishments focus on making the child suffer.
B) Logical consequences are always mild, while punishments are always severe.
C) Punishments are designed for teenagers; logical consequences are only for young children.
D) There is no functional difference.

multiple_choice_exam.question: What is the primary risk of using 'Indefinite Grounding' after a trust breach?
options: A) It makes parents look weak.
B) It deprives the child of a clear, actionable pathway to earn trust back, often leading to resentment and secrecy.
C) It requires too much paperwork.
D) It causes children to forget what rule they broke.

multiple_choice_exam.question: In the 'Gradual Release Framework', what is the main role of a parent during the 'Consultant Phase'?
options: A) To manage daily routines and enforce strict curfews directly.
B) To step back completely and ignore dangerous behavior.
C) To offer guidance and reflective questions while transferring problem-solving responsibility to the youth.
D) To pay for all expenses without asking questions.

multiple_choice_exam.question: What adjustment is essential when applying accountability systems to a child with ADHD?
options: A) Eliminating all boundaries and consequences.
B) Extending the delay between the behavior and the consequence.
C) Externalizing expectations using visual tools and keeping feedback loops immediate.
D) Relying exclusively on verbal lectures.

scenario_analysis.prompt: Synthesize a response to late-night electronics misuse using De-escalation, Logical Consequence, Restorative Repair, and Autonomy Benchmarks.
